annotations.title: Validate Costa Rica cédula (tax ID, beta)

description: Check a Costa Rican tax ID (cédula física, cédula jurídica, DIMEX or NITE) live against the Ministerio de Hacienda's public taxpayer lookup. Returns the ID type, taxpayer status (registered or not), tax regime, delinquent (moroso) and non-filer (omiso) flags, tax administration office, registered economic activities and a pass/review/fail assessment with reasons. Beta: the Hacienda endpoint is not formally documented. Names are returned only for legal entities; for individuals the name is withheld.

cedula.description: Costa Rican ID: 9 digits (cédula física), 10 digits (cédula jurídica or NITE) or 11-12 digits (DIMEX), e.g. "3-101-005744". Dashes are ignored.
